summary: The Pipeline's website job path is 11 units at the top, but its imports reach 1,317 of 1,621 modules (81% of lines), and code from the retired trial, G1, Astra, episode compilation, the rigid probe and RunPod is still pulled in by live modules along named edges. On the host, 206 of 207 failed units are stale experiments and the one real failure is the money guard, failing every run since 2026-11-13 because retired RunPod is still queried. No capture on the host has a company simulation package (4 have no source, 2 not permitted), retired lanes hold at least 67 GiB of disk, three armed timers serve no website job, and the nightly full test lane has been red four nights. Several trusted docs name deleted files, and production does not yet know the current Privacy version, so it blurs faces for new jobs until the next deploy.
